fnol_transcript_reference: Hi, um, my name is Clara Vance. I'm calling to file a death benefit claim on policy P-O-L-10001 for my mother, Eleanor Vance. Mom was completely healthy and active until she came down with a sudden, severe chest infection on February twelfth. We rushed her to Unity Hospital where the emergency room chest X-ray showed acute right lower lobe pneumonia, and sadly she passed away four days later. Her policy has been in force since June of twenty twenty.
aps_text_reference:
Patient Name: Eleanor Vance | Claim ID: CLM-LIFE-1001 | NIH Clinical Case Reference: PMC10405870 (PMID: 37554481)
Primary Diagnosis: ICD-10 J18.1 -- Acute Lobar Pneumonia, Right Lower Lobe, complicated by acute respiratory failure.
Date of First Symptom Onset: February 12, 2026 (68 months after policy issuance).
Clinical Presentation & Vitals: Patient presented febrile (38.1 C), tachycardic (110 bpm), tachypneic (RR 30), with oxygen saturation 92% on room air and coarse rhonchi over the right lower lung zone.
Radiograph Findings: Posteroanterior chest radiograph (PMC10405870 Fig. 1) demonstrates dense right lower lobe consolidation concerning for acute bacterial lobar pneumonia with normal cardiomediastinal silhouette.
Prior Medical History Audit: Review of 10-year primary care records confirms ZERO prior pulmonary or cardiac disease prior to February 2026.
policy_text_reference:
SECTION 1.1 -- DEATH BENEFIT COVERAGE
OmniLife Insurance Company agrees to pay the Base Sum Assured to the designated Beneficiary upon receipt of due proof of the Insured's death occurring while this Policy is in force.

SECTION 1.4 -- 24-MONTH INCONTESTABILITY CLAUSE
Except for non-payment of premiums, this Policy shall be incontestable after it has been in force during the lifetime of the Insured for a period of twenty-four (24) months from its Issue Date. Once the 24-month Contestability Window has elapsed, natural death claims substantiated by an Attending Physician Statement (APS) and consistent diagnostic imaging qualify for Fast-Track Payout.

SECTION 3.1 -- GENERAL EXCLUSIONS
Death resulting from suicide within twenty-four (24) months of the Issue Date limits liability to a refund of premiums paid.

policy_text_reference:
SECTION 1.4 -- BASE LIFE INCONTESTABILITY
After twenty-four (24) months from the Issue Date, the Base Life Sum Assured ($1,000,000) is incontestable and payable upon proof of death from any cause.

SECTION 4.1 -- ACCIDENTAL DEATH & DISMEMBERMENT (AD&D) RIDER BENEFIT
An additional 100% AD&D Rider Benefit ($1,000,000 Double Indemnity) is payable ONLY if death results directly and independently from external accidental bodily injury and is NOT excluded under Section 4.2.

SECTION 4.2 -- AD&D RIDER HAZARDOUS ACTIVITY & INTOXICATION EXCLUSIONS
No AD&D Rider Benefit shall be paid if the accidental injury or death occurs while the Insured is participating in:
  (a) Free-solo climbing, unroped technical mountaineering, or alpine ice climbing above 4,000 meters elevation;
  (b) Piloting or crew operation of any non-commercial private or experimental aircraft; or
  (c) Operating any vehicle or apparatus with a Blood Alcohol Concentration (BAC) of 0.08% or higher.
When Section 4.2 is triggered on an incontestable policy, Adjudication Action MUST be PARTIAL_APPROVE_BASE_DENY_ADD_RIDER (approving the Base Life Sum Assured while denying the AD&D Rider).

SECTION 2.1 -- QUALIFYING CRITICAL ILLNESS (CI) SEVERITY THRESHOLDS
The Critical Illness Living Benefit Rider pays a lump-sum accelerated benefit upon definitive diagnosis of Invasive Malignant Pulmonary Neoplasm, defined strictly as a primary lung tumor measuring >= 2.0 cm on thoracic radiograph/CT accompanied by histopathological biopsy confirmation (ICD-10 C34.x) after the 90-day waiting period.

All diagnostic radiographs submitted for Living Benefit claims are indexed via multimodal vector search against OmniLife's historical claims atlas.
